description_en: Creates a read-only instance for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS实例创建一个只读实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-read-only-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --db-instance-id 'rm-uf6wjk5****' --db-instance-class mysqlro.n2.small.1c --db-instance-storage 20 --engine-version 5.6 --pay-type Postpaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateReadOnlyDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. The region of the read-only instance must be the same as that of the primary instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。只读实例的地域必须和主实例相同。可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. You can invoke the DescribeRegions operation to query the zone ID.

For single-zone deployment, specify one zone ID, such as `cn-hangzhou-b`.
For multi-zone deployment, specify multiple zone IDs and separate them with colons (:), such as `cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`.
The number of specified zones must be less than or equal to the number of nodes in the read-only instance. A read-only instance of the Basic Edition contains only one node. A read-only instance of the high availability series contains two nodes (one primary node and one secondary node)
parameters.help_zh:
可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

若选择部署单可用区，填入一个可用区即可，例如`cn-hangzhou-b`。
若选择部署多可用区，填入多个可用区并用英文冒号（:）分隔，例如`cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`。
填入的可用区数量应小于或等于当前创建的只读实例内的节点数。基础系列只读实例内仅含1个节点，高可用系列只读实例内含有2个节点（1个主节点与1个备节点）
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 主实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html. Specify an instance type that is higher than or equal to the instance type of the primary instance. Otherwise, the read-only instance may experience high latency and high loads
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html。建议只读实例规格不小于主实例规格，否则易导致只读实例延迟高、负载高等现象
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: Instance storage capacity. Instance storage capacity of the read-only instance must be greater than or equal to instance storage capacity of the primary instance. Valid values: See the Storage capacity column in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html. The value must be a multiple of 5. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 存储空间，只读实例存储空间需要大于或等于主实例存储空间。取值：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html的**存储空间**列。每5 GB进行递增，单位：GB
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version. The value must be the same as the database engine version of the primary instance.

Valid values for MySQL: 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0.
Valid values for SQL Server: 2017_ent, 2019_ent, and 2022_ent.
Valid values for PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, and 15.0
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本号。必须与主实例相同。

MySQL数据库取值：5.6、5.7、8.0。
SQL Server数据库取值：2017_ent、2019_ent、2022_ent。
PostgreSQL数据库取值：10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The description of the instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a Chinese or English letter and can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The description cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
实例描述，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the read-only instance. Valid values:

VPC: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
Classic: classic network

By default, a VPC-type instance is created. If you set this parameter to VPC, you must also specify the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters.
The network type of the read-only instance can be different from that of the primary instance
parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的网络类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络
Classic：经典网络

默认创建专有网络实例，需要传入VPCId和VSwitchId。
只读实例的网络类型可以和主实例不同
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the read-only instance. This parameter is required when the InstanceNetworkType parameter is left empty or set to VPC.

If the primary instance uses Premium Local SSDs, you can select any VPC for the read-only instance.
If the primary instance uses cloud disks, the VPC of the read-only instance must be the same as that of the primary instance
parameters.help_zh:
只读实例的专有网络VPC ID。当InstanceNetworkType配置为空或VPC时需要传入。

主实例的存储类型为高性能本地盘时，只读实例可以选择任意VPC网络。
主实例的存储类型为云盘时，只读实例VPC必须和主实例保持一致
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the read-only instance. This parameter is required when the InstanceNetworkType parameter is left empty or set to VPC
parameters.help_zh: 只读实例的虚拟交换机ID。当InstanceNetworkType配置为空或VPC时需要传入
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: Settings for the internal network IP address of the read-only instance. The IP address must be within the address range of the specified vSwitch. By default, the system automatically allocates an IP address based on the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置只读实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition
HighAvailability: high availability series (default)
AlwaysOn: Cluster Edition

<props="china">* Finance: Finance Edition</props>

Read-only instances of ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL cloud disk instances only support the Basic Edition. Therefore, you must set this parameter to Basic
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列。取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列（默认值）
AlwaysOn：集群系列

<props="china">* Finance：金融版</props>

PostgreSQL云盘实例的只读实例为基础系列，因此必须传入Basic
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

local_ssd: Premium Local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
general_essd: high-performance cloud disk


If the primary ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance uses Premium Local SSDs, you can only set this parameter to local_ssd. If the primary instance uses cloud disks, you can only set this parameter to a cloud disk storage type.
ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server only supports cloud disk storage types
parameters.help_zh:
实例储存类型。取值：
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
general_essd：高性能云盘


RDS MySQL主实例为高性能本地盘，则仅支持传入local_ssd；RDS MySQL主实例为云盘，则仅支持传入云盘存储类型。
SQL Server仅支持传入云盘存储类型
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster where the read-only instance is created
parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时指定专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host on which the primary instance is deployed when you create the read-only instance in a dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh: 在专属集群内创建只读实例时，指定主实例的主机ID
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_master

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: gdn_instance_name

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: tddl_biz_type

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: tddl_region_config

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: instruction_set_arch

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If the Period parameter is set to Year, the value ranges from 1 to 5.
If the Period parameter is set to Month, the value ranges from 1 to 9.

This parameter is required when the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若PayType为Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period. Valid values:

Year: yearly subscription
Month: monthly subscription
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. This parameter is valid only when you create a subscription instance. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

If you purchase the instance on a monthly basis, the auto-renewal epoch is one month.
If you purchase the instance on a yearly basis, the auto-renewal epoch is one year
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，仅在创建包年包月实例时传入。取值：
true：是
false：否

按月购买，则自动续费周期为1个月。
按年购买，则自动续费周期为1年
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature for the ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values:

true: enables the release protection feature.
false: shutdown (default)

Release protection can be enabled only when the billing method is set to pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启RDS释放保护功能。取值：
true：开启
false：关闭（默认值）

仅计费方式为按量付费时支持开启
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
Supports initialization of the port when creating a read-only instance for an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL primary instance.

Valid values: 1000 to 65534
parameters.help_zh:
支持在RDS MySQL主实例创建只读实例时初始化端口。

取值范围：1000~65534
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The BpeEnabled
parameters.help_zh: 弃用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: bpe_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the I/O burst feature for https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html. Valid values:

true: enables the feature.
false: shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html的IO性能突发功能开关。取值：
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a DuckDB-based analytical instance. Valid values:

true: creates a DuckDB-based analytical instance.
false: does not create a DuckDB-based analytical instance.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL support DuckDB-based analytical instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建DuckDB分析实例。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭

当前仅RDS MySQL和RDS PostgreSQL支持创建DuckDB分析实例
parameters.name: is_analytic_read_only_ins

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false: generates an unpaid order.

Default value: true. If your payment method has an insufficient balance, you can set this parameter to false to generate an unpaid order. Then, you can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
false：只生成订单不扣费。




默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic creation of a proxy. Valid values:

true: enables automatic creation, and the default is a general-purpose proxy.

false: disables automatic creation
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动创建代理。取值：

true：开启自动创建，默认为通用代理。

false：不开启自动创建
parameters.name: auto_create_proxy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html feature for high-performance cloud disks. Valid values:

1: enables the feature.
0: disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html功能开关。取值：

1：开启
0：不开启
parameters.name: io_acceleration_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a voucher. Valid values:

true: uses a voucher.
false (default): does not use a voucher
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券。取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券code
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备用参数，无需配置
parameters.name: custom_extra_info

ConnectionString.description_en: The internal network database endpoint of the created read-only instance
ConnectionString.description_zh: 创建的只读实例内网数据库连接地址

DBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the created read-only instance

Port.description_en: The internal network database connection port of the created read-only instance
Port.description_zh: 创建的只读实例内网数据库连接端口
